originalTitle: Morocco detains dozens of migrants trying to cross into Ceuta, reports say
title: Helping People Find Safe Homes
content:
Hello, My Wonderful Friends from Africa!

Hello everyone! It’s your friendly African news reporter here, ready to share a story with you. Today, we're going to talk about people, journeys, and keeping everyone safe. It's a story about why some people travel to find new places to live. We want to understand and be kind to everyone, always.

What Happened Recently?

Imagine a country called Morocco. It’s a beautiful place in Africa with big deserts and lovely beaches! Some people from Morocco, and even from other countries nearby, sometimes want to go to a special city called Ceuta. Ceuta is very close to Morocco, but it’s actually a part of another country called Spain. It’s like a little piece of Spain right next to Morocco. Recently, some people wanted to travel to Ceuta. Many people tried to go at the same time. Because so many people were trying to go, the police and other helpers were there. Their job is super important: they help keep everyone safe and make sure things are peaceful. They want to make sure no one gets hurt. They talked to the people and helped them understand the rules of crossing borders. Did you know? Africa is a super big continent! It has 54 different countries, and each one is special and unique.

Where is Ceuta?

Let’s talk a little more about Ceuta. Look at a map! You’ll see Morocco in North Africa. Right on the very top of Morocco, you’ll see a little dot. That dot is Ceuta! It’s separated from Morocco by a fence and a border. Even though it's on the African continent, it belongs to Spain, which is in Europe. It's a very interesting place because it has a mix of different cultures and people. Imagine your garden has a fence. That fence is like a border between your garden and your neighbour's garden. Countries have much bigger borders to show where one country ends and another begins. To go from one country to another, you usually need special permission, like a passport.

Why Do People Travel So Far?

This is a very important question! People travel for many reasons. Sometimes, families move because a parent gets a new job in a different city. Sometimes, people move to be closer to their family members. Other times, people want to find a better school or new adventures. For some people in Africa, they might hear that there are more jobs or better schools in places like Europe. They dream of a happy future with good food, a safe home, and opportunities to learn and grow. So, they decide to make a long journey to try and find that new, happy life. Did you know? Many animals also travel long distances! This is called migration. For example, some birds fly from cold places to warm places when winter comes. People can migrate too!

Keeping Everyone Safe on Their Journey

When many people try to travel at once, it can sometimes be a bit confusing or even dangerous if not organised. That’s why the police and security helpers are there. They are not there to be mean, but to keep everyone safe and sound. Think of them like traffic controllers, making sure cars don't crash and everyone can move safely. They need to make sure that people cross borders in the right way, so that everyone can be counted and helped if they need it. If people try to cross where it's not safe, like over a high fence or through tricky water, they could get hurt. The helpers want to make sure everyone is okay. Did you know? Police officers are important helpers in our communities. They help us when we are lost, when we need help, and they keep us safe from harm.

What Happens to People Who Travel?

When people are stopped at a border, it means the helpers need to talk to them. They want to understand why they are travelling and what they need. Sometimes, people are asked to go back to their homes if they don't have the right papers to enter a new country. This can be sad, but it's part of the rules for countries to keep things organised and safe for everyone. But many good people and groups also work hard to help those who are travelling. They try to give them food, water, a safe place to rest, and medical care if they are sick. Everyone deserves to be treated with kindness, especially when they are far from home. Did you know? There are many wonderful charities and organisations that help people who are travelling and need a safe place to stay. They are like super helpers!

Let's All Be Kind and Understand

This story reminds us that people all over the world have dreams. They want good things for their families, just like you and your family. Sometimes, making a big journey is the way they try to reach those dreams. It’s important for us to remember that everyone deserves kindness and understanding. Let’s think about how we can be good friends and neighbours to everyone, no matter where they come from. We can learn about different places and people, and always try to help if we see someone who needs it. When we are kind, we make the whole world a better, happier, and safer place for everyone. Let’s spread love and understanding today!
summary: Police in Morocco helped people who were trying to travel to Ceuta, a city that belongs to Spain, to make sure everyone stayed safe while looking for new homes.
whyMatters: This story matters because it helps us understand that some people travel far to find a new, happy home, and it's important for everyone to be safe and kind to each other.

originalTitle: The Polygamist's author says women see themselves reflected in her Netflix hit
title: Meet Sue, Our African Book Hero!
content:
Hello, my wonderful friends! Your kid-friendly news reporter is here from beautiful Africa! Today, we have a super exciting story to share with you about a very special lady from a country called Zimbabwe. Her name is Sue Nyathi, and she is a real-life hero who writes amazing books!

Our Super Storyteller!

Imagine you have a big imagination, full of fun stories and interesting people. A novelist is someone who takes all those amazing ideas from their head and writes them down into a whole book! It's like being a storyteller, but with a pen and paper, or a computer. Sue Nyathi is one of these amazing storytellers, and she comes from our very own continent, Africa!

She writes stories that make people think and feel. Her stories are so good that they are loved by many, many people. It takes a lot of hard work and thinking to write a book, but Sue loves doing it. She pours her heart into every single page, and that's what makes her books so special.

What is a Novelist, Exactly?

You might be wondering, what exactly does a 'novelist' do? Well, a novelist is like a dream-weaver! They create whole new worlds and people with their words. They think of characters, what they look like, how they talk, what adventures they go on, and what lessons they learn.

Then, they put all these thoughts into sentences, then paragraphs, then chapters, until they have a whole book! It's like building a big, beautiful house with words. Sue Nyathi has built many beautiful story-houses for us to explore.

Did you know? The word 'novel' comes from an old word that means 'new thing' or 'new story'!

Her Special Book: 'The Polygamist'

Sue wrote a very special book called 'The Polygamist'. It's a big word, but it just means a story about a kind of family where one person might have more than one husband or wife. Her book helps us understand different families and how people live. It's full of exciting things that happen to the people in the story!

This book explores the lives of women in these special families. It talks about their feelings, their challenges, and their dreams. It's a story that lets us peek into the lives of others and learn about different ways of living in our world. Sue wants everyone to understand and respect different kinds of families and people.

From Book to TV! What is Netflix?

Now, imagine your favourite story suddenly comes alive on your TV! That's what happened with Sue's book! It became a super popular TV show on something called Netflix. Netflix is like a giant library of movies and TV shows you can watch at home on a TV, tablet, or phone. So many people watched her story and loved it!

It's a huge honour for a book to be turned into a TV show. It means the story is so good and so important that people wanted to see it acted out by real people on screen. Sue's book becoming a 'Netflix hit' means lots of people, not just in Africa but all around the world, are watching and enjoying her story!

Did you know? Netflix started in 1997, which is a long, long time ago, even before you were born!

Why Girls and Women Love Her Book

Sue Nyathi says that when women watch the show or read her book, they feel like the characters are just like them. This means they might say, 'Oh, I understand how that character feels!' or 'That's just like something that happened to my auntie or my mum!' It makes them feel happy and understood.

When a story makes you feel like you're not alone, and that someone understands what you're going through, that's a very powerful thing. Sue's stories help women feel seen and heard. They can relate to the struggles and joys of the characters, which makes the book very special to them.

A Big Step: Paying for Her Own Book

Starting something new can be a little bit scary, right? Especially writing a whole book and getting it printed! Sue loved her story so much that she paid for her very first book, 'The Polygamist,' to be made all by herself. This is called 'self-funding' or 'self-publishing'.

It means she used her own money to print the book and share it with the world. How brave and determined is that? She believed in her story so much that she made sure it got into people's hands. It was a big risk, but it shows how much passion she has for telling stories.

Did you know? Many famous authors also struggled to get their first books published, but they never gave up!

Writing Can Be Hard Work and Cost Money!

Writing books is super fun and creative, but sometimes it costs money to make them into real books that people can hold and read. You need to pay for someone to help make the words perfect (an editor), and someone to design the cover, and then for the actual printing.

It can also take a very, very long time to write a book – sometimes many years! So, Sue is asking a big question: 'Is it easy for everyone to write a book, even if they don't have a lot of money or time?' It's a very important question, because everyone has amazing stories to tell! She wants to make sure that people who love to write can do it, no matter how much money they have.

Did you know? The longest novel ever written has over 13 million words! Imagine how long that would take to write!

A Dream Come True and a Lesson for Us!

From writing her first book and paying for it herself, to seeing it become a huge TV show on Netflix, Sue Nyathi's journey is like a dream come true! It teaches us that if you work hard, believe in your dreams, and have a special talent like storytelling, amazing things can happen.

Her story reminds us that even when things are tough, like finding money to print a book, you should never give up on what you love to do. Sue Nyathi is a wonderful example for all of us in Africa and around the world, showing us the power of stories and determination!

Thank you for listening, my friends! See you next time with more exciting news from Africa!
summary: Zimbabwean author Sue Nyathi paid for her first book, 'The Polygamist,' which became a popular Netflix show, and now she wonders if all aspiring writers can afford to share their stories.
whyMatters: This story is important because it shows us how hard work and belief can make dreams come true, like Sue's book becoming a TV show. It also makes us think about how we can help everyone tell their amazing stories, even if they don't have a lot of money.
